_comment: Retrieval evaluation set for the demo corpus in docs/.
Deliberately bilingual: the real usage pattern is Russian questions against
English documents, which is exactly what an English-only embedding model
silently fails at. 'expected' lists the source(s) that must be retrieved.
Questions whose answer genuinely appears in two documents list both.

_negative_comment: Out-of-domain questions. Nothing in docs/ answers these, so the retriever
should rank everything it returns much further away than for a real question.
The bot must answer 'I don't know' rather than improvise from whatever came back.
